mapper.select: SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , sonik.jm_sonik AS jm_sonik , sonik.pg_sonik AS pg_sonik , sonik.pg_premium AS pg_premium , sonik.put_premium AS premium , sonik.un_sonik AS un_sonik FROM SZT0IA_V t1 , SZM0IA ia , (SELECT ta.FUND_CD , SUM(NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK, 0)) AS jm_sonik , SUM(ta.JM_PG_SONIK) AS pg_sonik , SUM(ta.PUT_PG_PREMIUM) AS pg_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.PUT_BF_PREMIUM, 0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM, 0)) AS put_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.PUT_BF_PREMIUM, 0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK, 0) + NVL(ta.JM_PG_SONIK, 0)) AS un_sonik FROM USPM_SONIK ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ta.YMD = #{ymd} GROUP BY ta.FUND_CD) sonik WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{ymd} AND NVL(t1.DEL, 'N') = 'N' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND sonik.fund_cd(+) = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.JISU_YMD, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS jisu_ymd , TO_CHAR(#{ymd}, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS today , t1.SPX_START AS spx_start , t1.SPX_TODAY AS spx_today , t1.NDX_START AS ndx_start , t1.NDX_TODAY AS ndx_today , t1.FUND_START AS fund_start , t1.FUND_TODAY AS fund_today , CASE WHEN t1.SPX_START > 0 THEN (t1.SPX_TODAY / NULLIF(t1.SPX_START, 0)) - 1 ELSE NULL END AS spx_rt , CASE WHEN t1.NDX_START > 0 THEN (t1.NDX_TODAY / NULLIF(t1.NDX_START, 0)) - 1 ELSE NULL END AS ndx_rt , CASE WHEN t1.FUND_START > 0 THEN (t1.FUND_TODAY / NULLIF(t1.FUND_START, 0)) - 1 ELSE NULL END AS fund_rt FROM TABLE(F_JA032N (#{corpGr}, #{ymd}, #{fundCd})) t1

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.PORT AS port , SUM(t1.PUT_PG_PREMIUM) AS pg_premium , SUM(t1.PUT_BF_PREMIUM) AS bf_premium , SUM(t1.PUT_UP_PREMIUM) AS up_premium , SUM(t1.PUT_DW_PREMIUM) AS dw_premium , SUM(NVL(t1.PUT_BF_PREMIUM, 0) + NVL(t1.SA3_PREMIUM, 0)) AS premium , SUM(NVL(t1.JM_BF_SONIK, 0) - NVL(t1.JM_UP_SONIK, 0)) AS jm_sonik , SUM(t1.JM_PG_SONIK) AS pg_sonik FROM USPM_SONIK t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{ymd}, -1) AND #{ymd} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} GROUP BY t1.CORP_GR, t1.YMD, t1.FUND_CD, t1.PORT ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC, t1.PORT ASC
